breaking.change: SaveEdit.types answers a Result, as the host always did: { ok: true, value: SaveType[] }, refused once the save is closed. It used to be typed as the bare list, and the runtime answered [] for a closed save.
breaking.fix: Check `.ok` and read `.value`: `const t = edit.types(); if (t.ok) for (const type of t.value) ...`.

breaking.change: og.render.display is typed DisplayInfo | null: it answers null when the world has no engine or its renderer cannot be read at that moment, which it always did but the type did not say.
breaking.fix: Check for null before reading the answer: `const d = og.render.display(world); if (d) save(d.settings);`.
